column7: postgres and mysql admin_dsns were not under dynamic_secrets.insecure_allow_plaintext_dynamic_secret_transport at all: sslmode disable/allow/prefer/require (and no sslmode, pgx default prefer) and mysql tls=false/skip-verify/preferred/allowFallbackToPlaintext connected without verifying the server certificate whatever the operator's policy said. The engines now decide from the parsed driver config (every attempt and fallback must verify) and refuse unless the flag is set (WARNING when it is); core refuses a new or edited weak admin_dsn on save (TestDynamicSecrets_CreateConfig_RefusesSQLTransportThatDoesNotVerify, TestDynamicSecrets_UpdateAdminDSN_RefusesSQLTransportThatDoesNotVerify); a stored one keeps issuing during the dsn.StoredSQLTransportGrace soft period with a dynamic_lease.insecure_transport audit event per issue (TestDynamicSecrets_IssueLease_StoredWeakSQLTransportAuditedEveryIssue). Revoke upgrades to verified TLS instead of refusing (TestPostgresEngine_Revoke_UnverifiedSSLModeUpgradedNotRefused, TestMySQLEngine_Revoke_UnverifiedTLSUpgradedNotRefused). MySQL: TestMySQLEngine_RefusesTLSSettingsThatDoNotVerify. Class guard TestSQLTransport_NoSpellingConnectsUnverifiedUnrefused (mined driver vocabulary as keys and values). Red on main, green after.
